task_text: Clear all main tables and counters

central_instructions.R1: R1, clear all light objects from the main tables in the kitchen and pass them to R2 for further processing.
central_instructions.R2: R2, receive light objects from R1 and ensure all counters in the kitchen are cleared of light objects.
central_instructions.R3: R3, clear all light objects from the main tables in the living room and pass them to R4 for further processing.
central_instructions.R4: R4, receive light objects from R3 and ensure all counters in the living room are cleared of light objects.

agent_plans.R1:
[0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the apple from the main table. (r1_s1)
- R1 [PASS] Pass the apple to R2. (r1_s2)
- R2 [RECEIVE] Receive the apple from R1. (r2_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the book from the main table. (r1_s3)
- R1 [PASS] Pass the book to R2. (r1_s4)
- R2 [RECEIVE] Receive the book from R1. (r2_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the mouse from the main table. (r1_s5)
- R1 [PASS] Pass the mouse to R2. (r1_s6)
- R2 [RECEIVE] Receive the mouse from R1. (r2_s3)
agent_plans.R2:
[0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up a light object from the counter (r1_s1)
- R1 [PASS] Hand the light object to R2 (r1_s2)
- R2 [RECEIVE] Receive the light object from R1 (r2_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Place the light object in the designated storage area (r2_s2)
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up another light object from the counter (r1_s3)
- R1 [PASS] Hand the light object to R2 (r1_s4)
- R2 [RECEIVE] Receive the light object from R1 (r2_s3)

[10-15 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Place the light object in the designated storage area (r2_s4)
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the last light object from the counter (r1_s5)
- R1 [PASS] Hand the light object to R2 (r1_s6)
- R2 [RECEIVE] Receive the light object from R1 (r2_s5)

[15-20 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Place the light object in the designated storage area (r2_s6)
agent_plans.R3:
[0-5 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Identify all light objects on the main tables. (r3_s1)
- R3 [LOCAL] Pick up the first light object from the coffee table. (r3_s2)

[5-10 min]
- R3 [PASS] Pass the first light object to R4. (r3_s3)
- R3 [LOCAL] Pick up the second light object from the coffee table. (r3_s4)

[10-15 min]
- R3 [PASS] Pass the second light object to R4. (r3_s5)
- R3 [LOCAL] Move to the side table and pick up a light object. (r3_s6)

[15-20 min]
- R3 [PASS] Pass the light object from the side table to R4. (r3_s7)
- R3 [LOCAL] Confirm all main tables are clear of light objects. (r3_s8)
agent_plans.R4:
[0-5 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Collects light objects from the main table. (r3_s1)
- R4 [RECEIVE] Prepares to receive objects from R3. (r4_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R3 [PASS] Hands light objects to R4. (r3_s2)
- R4 [RECEIVE] Receives light objects from R3. (r4_s2)

[10-15 min]
- R4 [LOCAL] Moves to the counter and places received objects in storage. (r4_s3)

[15-20 min]
- R3 [LOCAL] Checks for any remaining light objects on the main table. (r3_s3)
- R4 [LOCAL] Ensures all counters are clear of light objects. (r4_s4)
